# Game Idea: Neon Grid Escape

- **Genre**: Arcade / Reflex
- **Core mechanic**: Control a glowing square navigating an endless scrolling neon grid.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible while avoiding randomly spawning spikes and moving laser walls.
- **Lose condition**: The player loses instantly when the square collides with any spike or laser wall, or falls off the bottom of the grid.
- **Canvas friendly**: Simple shapes and animations can be rendered with `requestAnimationFrame` and basic 2D canvas drawing.

1: // game.js – simple Neon Grid Escape implementation
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Sound effects using HTMLAudioElement with data URIs
7:   const hitSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short beep
8:   const spawnSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // placeholder beep
9:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
13: 
14:   // Player
15:   const player = {
16:     size: 20,
17:     x: width / 2 - 10,
18:     y: height - 40,
19:     speed: 4,
20:     color: '#0ff',
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Game state
24:   let spikes = [];
25:   let lasers = [];
26:   let gridOffset = 0;
27:   let frame = 0;
28:   let score = 0;
29:   let running = true;
30: 
31:   // Input handling
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
35: 
36:   function spawnSpike() {
37:     const size = 20;
38:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
39:     spikes.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed: 2, color: '#f0f' });
40:     // play spawn sound
41:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
42:     spawnSound.play();
43:   }
44: 
45:   function spawnLaser() {
46:     const thickness = 8;
47:     const y = -thickness;
48:     const speed = 1.5;
49:     const direction = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1; // left to right or reverse
50:     const length = Math.random() * (width / 2) + width / 4;
51:     const startX = direction === 1 ? -length : width;
52:     lasers.push({ x: startX, y, length, thickness, speed, direction, color: '#f00' });
53:     // play spawn sound
54:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
55:     spawnSound.play();
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update() {
59:     if (!running) return;
60:     // Move player
61:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
62:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
64:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
65:     // Keep within bounds
66:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.size, player.x));
67:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - player.size, player.y));
68: 
69:     // Update spikes
70:     spikes.forEach(s => s.y += s.speed);
71:     spikes = spikes.filter(s => s.y < height);
72: 
73:     // Update lasers
74:     lasers.forEach(l => {
75:       l.y += l.speed;
76:       l.x += l.speed * l.direction;
77:     });
78:     lasers = lasers.filter(l => l.y < height && (l.direction === 1 ? l.x < width : l.x > -l.length));
79: 
80:     // Spawn obstacles
81:     if (frame % 80 === 0) spawnSpike();
82:     if (frame % 200 === 0) spawnLaser();
83: 
84:     // Collision detection
85:     const hit = spikes.some(s =>
86:       player.x < s.x + s.size && player.x + player.size > s.x &&
87:       player.y < s.y + s.size && player.y + player.size > s.y);
88:     const laserHit = lasers.some(l => {
89:       // laser is a moving rectangle
90:       const lx = l.x;
91:       const ly = l.y;
92:       const lw = l.length;
93:       const lh = l.thickness;
94:       return player.x < lx + lw && player.x + player.size > lx &&
95:              player.y < ly + lh && player.y + player.size > ly;
96:     });
97:     if (hit || laserHit) {
98:       // play hit sound
99:       hitSound.currentTime = 0;
100:       hitSound.play();
101:       running = false;
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Grid scrolling effect
105:     gridOffset = (gridOffset + 2) % 40;
106:     frame++;
107:     score = Math.floor(frame / 60);
108:   }
109: 
110:   function drawGrid() {
111:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
112:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
113:     for (let x = gridOffset; x < width; x += 40) {
114:       ctx.beginPath();
115:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
116:       ctx.lineTo(x, height);
117:       ctx.stroke();
118:     }
119:     for (let y = gridOffset; y < height; y += 40) {
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
122:       ctx.lineTo(width, y);
123:       ctx.stroke();
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   function render() {
128:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
129:     // Background – neon gradient
130:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
131:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#010024');
132:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#090979');
133:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
134:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
135:     // Grid with glow
136:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
137:     ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
138:     drawGrid();
139:     // Reset glow for other elements
140:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
141:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
142:     // Player – glowing square
143:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
144:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
145:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
146:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
147:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
148:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
149:     // Spikes – glowing triangles
150:     spikes.forEach(s => {
151:       ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
152:       ctx.shadowColor = s.color;
153:       ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
154:       ctx.beginPath();
155:       ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + s.size);
156:       ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y);
157:       ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y + s.size);
158:       ctx.closePath();
159:       ctx.fill();
160:       ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
161:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
162:     });
163:     // Lasers – glowing gradient rectangles
164:     lasers.forEach(l => {
165:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(l.x, l.y, l.x + l.length, l.y);
166:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)');
167:       grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,0,0,0.9)');
168:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)');
169:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
170:       ctx.shadowColor = l.color;
171:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
172:       ctx.fillRect(l.x, l.y, l.length, l.thickness);
173:       ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
174:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
175:     });
176:     // Score
177:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
178:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
179:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
180:     if (!running) {
181:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
182:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
183:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
184:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
185:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
186:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
187:     }
188:   }
189: 
190:   function loop() {
191:     if (running) {
192:       update();
193:     }
194:     render();
195:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196:   }
197: 
198:   // Start the game
199:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200: })();

(End of file - total 200 lines)
</content>
